svg.aria-label: Sorting algorithms mechanism map: comparison sorts versus the non-comparison exception, and seven variant diagrams.
svg.text: Six algorithms here only ever ask "is A bigger than B?" — that question alone caps
them at O(n log n). The seventh sidesteps the question entirely.
Comparison sorts vs. the one exception
log₂(n!) ≈ n log n is the proven floor for anything that only compares — counting sort
isn't faster at the same game, it's playing a different one.
Six comparison shapes, one non-comparison exception
